2125302430153965780.zh_summary: Elon 的巨型合併！SpaceX $SPCX 和 Tesla $TSLA 剛剛任命五名獨立董事來談判可能的全股票交易，價值約 3.5 萬億美元。這將是史上最大，條款可能最早於 12 月出台。

2125302116444991865.en_summary: 10 years ago, Nvidia's $NVDA TTM revenue was just 60% higher than AMD's $AMD. Now, that gap has widened with Nvidia's TTM revenue 8X higher than AMD's.
